en_before: Outerwear should work with the length of both the skirt and boots. If the coat hem, skirt hem, and boot tops all end close together, change one length to give the outfit some breathing room. If you need a layer for a cold room, see our guide to layering women’s outfits and try the outfit with the coat in your hand. The clothes underneath should still look complete when the outer layer comes off.
